system.flavor: A modern French sniper's rifle with bipod, computer-assisted laser scope and sound suppressor.
system.notes:
Eurosource p.58 (Eurosource_OCR.pdf idx 58) text layer, confirmed by a fresh tesseract pass at four zoom/psm settings which resolves the WA cell the shipped layer drops: RIF 4 N P 6d6+2 (7.62) 10 2 ST. Eurosource's weapon sidebars print no cost and no range column.

Cost and range from Blackhand's Street Weapons p.30 (PDF idx 31), citing [Eurosource]: 1100eb, RIF +3 N P 6D6+2 (7.62MM) 10 2 ST 500M, bipod +1 WA at Long/Extreme range. Eurosource's printed WA 4 is kept - this is the same +3-vs-4 disagreement that module/data-corrections.js already patches on the base-pack copy.
